title: phpMyFAQ 4.1.9 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an improper restriction of excessive…
description: phpMyFAQ versions 4.1.9 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 have a vulnerability in the PasswordChangeController::update() function. This flaw allows attackers with a hijacked admin session to bypass throttling on authentication attempts and repeatedly guess the old password using a reusable CSRF token, potentially leading to account takeover.
